title: An HF-ordering is over the set it closes
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 346-347: if an order is an HF-ordering of B and A equals its own closure, then the order is an HF-ordering of B over A. The proof (source lines 348-349) is a contradiction argument whose steps the statement hides: from the failure of the property one extracts an element outside A and two distinct blocks containing it, each of whose other members is either below it or in A; one then has to show, for each block, that the relevant member is below the chosen element, because the opposite would place an element below it inside A, and only then does the closure hypothesis produce the contradiction with the defining condition of an HF-ordering.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line
